title: Low-cost sensors for continuous air quality monitoring in classrooms
summary: We deployed 120 low-cost sensors in 40 schools for one year and show that, after calibration, they track reference monitors within 8%.
significance: Our results show that schools can monitor indoor air quality at one tenth of the usual cost.
fit: The work fits the journal's focus on environmental exposure assessment.
data_availability: All data and code are openly available on Zenodo.
